summary.intent: Resume the callisto-hardening follow-up work: move CI off the retired macos-14 runner, then unblock the failing Release workflow on main, and design a robust recovery model for interrupted `callisto version` runs (E208 after lockfile refresh failure).
summary.outcome: macos-14 moved to macos-15 (#421, merged, trail #159) and then to macos-latest (#422 draft, trail #160); stale release commit revert branch/trail created; 22 stale worktrees/branches cleaned up; a local git-ref checkpoint spike was prototyped and validated across 8+ workspace shapes, with an ADR (docs/adr-version-checkpoint) about to be drafted but nothing pushed.

repo: Release failure root cause: #420 rewrote/deleted the 8 changesets that release PR #409 was built from; the release-PR refresh step failed, #409 merged anyway, so its release commit consumed no changesets and every push to main fails with E165 at 'Derive and hash intent'. Nothing was published (latest tag 0.16.0).
Callisto has no guard preventing a stale release PR from merging after changesets change on main.
ADR 10 makes the native ecosystem tool the oracle for lockfile resolution after `version`; core must not reimplement resolver rules (e.g. Cargo dev-dependency coverage).
versioning.md documents retain-inputs recovery: apply refreshes lockfile and stages before consuming changesets; E121 is the stated limit of recovery for interrupted runs, not a bug.
Apply is already idempotent via from/to guard (`write_version_guarded`); changelog skips an existing version heading, so resume replay is safe.
Replanning from HEAD versions alone is wrong for mixed Cargo+npm: specs already rewritten on disk make the cascade skip a package, giving a silent inconsistency with exit 0.

Git-ref checkpoint spike (refs/callisto/...) matched a clean run in 8 shapes (Cargo, fixed group, mixed, Python uv.lock, workspace below repo root, pre mode, untracked changeset, symlinked yarn.lock); a hand edit between runs is refused with E117.

Checkpoint facts: commit-tree isn't signed (still pass --no-gpg-sign), second concurrent create is refused, `push --all/--tags` don't push it but `push --mirror` does, shallow clones work, whole-repo snapshot costs ~80ms but 3.2s with a 200MB untracked file (limit to workspace + release inputs), stale worktree after resume crash needs `git worktree prune`.
Resume must refuse if config, changesets or pre.json changed vs the checkpoint; checkpoint should also store the index as a separate tree for exact abort.
Runner labels: every runner in .github is ubuntu-latest except ubuntu-24.04-arm (no -latest label); matrix.rs already uses macos-latest.

Survey of other sites: `snapshot` and the `--emit-decision/--emit-preview` tail of `version` fit the pattern; `pre enter/exit` should just be made idempotent; init/add/release/release-pr/compose-pr-body don't fit.
CommandRunner needs a general env-var entry point to pass GIT_INDEX_FILE (mechanism exists for publisher credentials).

code.finding: macOS artifact preflight matrix entries pinned runner: macos-14 (changed to macos-15, then macos-latest).
Release artifact build matrix pinned runner: macos-14; builds the macOS release binaries.
Planning reads base versions from disk via ws.base_versions(); this is the seam that makes naive resume wrong.
manifest_version_at reads effective manifest version at HEAD including inheritance; used by E121.
write_version_guarded skips manifests already at target and refuses ones at neither old nor new version.
Apply stages first, and removes changesets/pre.json from disk only after git rm --cached succeeds.
States retained changesets are the recovery material after a failed refresh; automatic replay is explicitly not guaranteed.
--emit-decision/--emit-preview are written after apply consumes changesets, so a failure there loses the ability to rederive the decision.

workflow: The `!` shell prefix only works as the entire prompt with nothing before it; otherwise it arrives as text and doesn't run.
Entire titles sessions from the first prompt, not Claude Code's names, so search by session id; Entire checkpoints lag behind current-day work.
The sandbox blocks Entire network (TLS error), GPG signing, ssh-agent and gh token minting; these commands needed unsandboxed runs or user-run `!` commands.
Entire auto-opens a draft PR when a trail is created for a branch; edit the PR rather than creating one.
Verify differentially with a throwaway harness before designing: it disproved the 'plan from HEAD' resume design before any code shipped.
Read existing ADRs and architecture docs before proposing mechanisms; doing so reversed two earlier recommendations (rollback, post-condition refresh).
Squash merges defeat `git branch -d`, so cleanup of merged branches needs `-D` after verifying no unique commits.

friction: Could not find the 'callisto-hardening' session by name; had to infer it from local transcripts and Entire by session id.
Sandbox TLS/proxy errors blocked Entire, the GitHub changelog fetch, and runner docs, so the macos-14 retirement date and macos-26 availability stayed unconfirmed.
GPG signing, ssh-agent access and `gh pr create` (orin-dx-pr-bot key OpenSSL 'unsupported') failed in the sandbox.
User's `! ssh-add` attempts arrived as plain text twice (placeholder and prefix issues).
Rollback work in #543 grew through four review rounds of edge cases before the design was reconsidered; user was severely disappointed the assistant hadn't reframed the root problem itself.
Several assistant recommendations were reversed after reading the architecture docs, costing iteration time.
confirm.sh had a flag-order bug (`--no-gpg-sign` before `commit-tree`) so the first run validated nothing.
Formatting hook blocked the spike commit, so changes followed onto the ADR branch and had to be moved back.
The subagent survey found the spike had a malformed `git :/ add -A`, `.expect()` panics, and deleted the ref before emit writes.
open_items: Draft the ADR on git-ref checkpoints (begin/complete/resume/abort) on branch docs/adr-version-checkpoint, with rejected options and the differential harness as acceptance test.

Revert branch fix/revert-stale-release-commit and trail 'A stale release PR can no longer wedge releases' still need pushing/merging; the Release workflow on main is still failing until the revert lands.
Find why 'Create or update the Callisto release PR' failed on the #420 push, and add a guard so a stale release PR can't merge; decide whether E165 should be recoverable without a manual revert.
Investigate `tag candidate callisto-graph@0 matched glob but placeholder 0 is not a valid SemVer version` warnings from `callisto status`.
Close #543 (rollback) and open a docs-only fix making E208 text accurate.
Make `pre enter/exit` idempotent in a separate small PR.

Remaining checkpoint checks: tag-sensitive inference/fixed-group alignment between runs, submodules, just bench, abort command design, signing flag, scoping snapshot to workspace paths, coded errors instead of .expect().
Approve trails #159 and #160 in Entire (Entire Gates); close trail #159; watch CI on #422 and confirm what macos-latest resolves to.
Confirm macos-14 retirement date on GitHub changelog.
Remaining cleanup: smoke-main (441 deleted files), wf_cd627354-1a0-2 (untracked test file), callisto-homebrew-tap, stack/docs-v1, remote merged branches, stale audit trails #139-#152 and #129/#130.
Original plan items: spec drift re-verification, #290 guard gaps, npm/monorepo exclusion shape, E194, T12 registry tests, matrix.rs target triples, npm OIDC trusted publishing.
